title: Nebula Cognitive Engine One 2
description: Built as the Signature version of Llama 3.2 — multimodal language model family, the Nebula Cognitive Engine One 2 reproduces its operational facts in original expression — adds vision understanding to the open model family. Its 2024 release positioned it for developers.

demo.title: Interactive record tour — Nebula Cognitive Engine One 2
